question: Identify the committee constituted for the promotion of small scale industries.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hanumanth Commitee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The committee constituted for the promotion of small-scale industries is the **Hanumanth Committee.**
 
• Hanumanth Committee:** Formed in 1997**, it focused on issues related to the growth and promotion of small-scale and medium-sized enterprises in India.
 
• It was headed by** Dr. C. H. Hanumantha Rao**, an economist and former Director of the National Institute of Rural Development.
 
• Emphasized the role of small industries in promoting **regional development and balancing industrial growth** across different areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Karve Committee**, officially known as the “Committee on the Status of Women in India,” was **established in 1971**.
 
• The committee was constituted by the Government of India under the chairmanship of **Dr. D. D. Karve** in 1971.
 
• The** Raja Chelliah Committee**, formally known as the Committee on Tax Reforms, was **established in 1991**.
 
• It was chaired by **Dr. Raja J. Chelliah**, an eminent economist and a prominent figure in India's economic policy formulation.
 
• The **Kelkar Committee**, officially known as the Task Force on the Goods and Services Tax (GST), was **constituted in 2003**.
 
• It was chaired by **Dr. Vijay Kelkar**, an eminent economist and former Chairman of the Finance Commission.
